name: Kiva Grill
description: Located on the Fort Morgan peninsula of Gulf Shores, Alabama, Kiva Grill has a comprehensive breakfast and lunch menu that will satisfy anyone. Open to the public seven days a week, the grill has a warm atmosphere with a full bar. Beat the beach crowds and experience one of the best brunches on the island! Located inside Kiva Lodge at 815 Plantation Rd. Gulf Shores, AL 36542
